RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

Panel composition alone is not evidence of bias; panels are typically assigned based on seniority and availability. In civil service recruitment, candidates are assessed against standardized competency frameworks and interview performance. The successful candidate possesses relevant credentials, and her international project experience may have aligned better with specific role requirements.

Challenging the panel’s gender composition without concrete evidence—such as improper questioning or documented procedural breaches—will appear unfounded and could seriously harm your professional reputation. A two-week delay for written feedback is standard in public sector HR. Politely follow up to request your scoring matrix and constructive feedback to understand how the final decision was reached.
